mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% in the current month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC for the trigger condition remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in unemployment rate signals monetary policy response to labor market deterioration, preceding economic weakness that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (three consecutive months of rising housing starts), consumer confidence and construction activity boost economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC for the regime condition falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior quarter signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO increases in the prior quarter, or Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales decline by more than 0.5% in the current month, it indicates weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenues, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when RSAFS declines by more than 0.5%, or Rank IC for the trigger condition falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Positive year-over-year growth in real GDP signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive year-over-year, or Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (annualized CPIAUCSL below 2.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation is below 2.0%, or Rank IC for the regime condition falls below 0.03.
